page.notes: The page number 225 and the handwritten "2" at the top right are manuscript annotations, not printed; the number is recorded as printed only where it is in print. The "b" with a mark at the upper left is handwriting and is left out. The date reads CIↃ IↃ LXXXIX, transcribed as printed in the old numeral form (clo lo), with the reversed-C forms rendered as MDLXXXIX. The ornament is a printer's device. The first title line is set in spaced capitals and the printed line "CONFVTATIO" is transcribed in full. Lines of the printed title show faint ink and a stain near the middle; the word "recoēta" is uncertain [?] in the printed form.
